texts.preamble: Kodisi Kishore Raja vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 30 July, 2021 Author: R. Raghunandan Rao Bench: R. Raghunandan Rao Hon'Ble Sri Justice R. Raghunandan Rao W.P.No.14622 of 2021 Order:
texts.arguments: 2. The petitioner assails these impugned orders on the ground that the principles of natural justice have not been followed and the order is a non-speaking order. 3. Heard Sri Y.N. Anjaneyacharyulu, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for respondents. 4. A perusal of the impugned order shows that the order, except recording the facts leading to the case, does not set out any reason as to why the 5th respondent-adjudicating officer had arrived at the conclusion that there were violations of the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
